svg.title: How do live and saved copies become one visible message?
svg.desc: In this example, live and saved observations describe the same text unit M42. The saved copy supplies the visible text; the matching live copy is suppressed. An independent tool result keeps its own place.
svg.text: How do live and saved copies become one visible message?
Rendering ownership · illustrative content IDs, not text-based deduplication

svg.text: Blue: Agent Code · Gray / dashed border: external · Amber: checks and cautions
Arrow: read its label in the arrow direction. Cylinder: stored data. Diamond: a check.
